text_block_list.name: Station Advertisement
text_block_list.text:
"—A moment of healing for hard-working 
you... Our 'Relaxation Fair' is underway♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! They had something like that going 
on? Lucky~ I wonder if there's any new 
merch out?
choice_data_list:
Since we're nearby, want to drop by for a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! Huh, are you sure!? I'll gladly take you 
up on that offer, then~.
choice_data_list: せっかくだし少し寄っていく？

text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been struggling to shake off 
the fatigue from work. This might be a 
good opportunity.
choice_data_list: 俺も見ていきたいから
私も見ていきたいから

text_block_list.text: Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
âAh, a squishy cushion! I've had my eye 
on this, too~.

I picked up the cushion Hishi Miracle had 
her eye on... I see, this really is nice.
choice_data_list: Looks like we could use this for training.
Looks like we could use this for training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I sup... pose? It does seem pretty 
handy for muscle training~.
choice_data_list: これ、トレーニングで使えそうだな
これ、トレーニングで使えそうだね

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, shouldn't we just relax like 
normal first? These are relaxation goods 
after all~"
choice_data_list: Oh, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘Relaxation time’ is pretty important, 
after all. It's fine to forget about work 
and take it easy for just today~."
choice_data_list: あ、そうだった

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I came here to soothe my fatigue, 
so this is completely defeating the 
purpose. Composing myself, I head to the 
next shop.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this foot care stone is great~. You 
can massage the soles of your feet while 
sitting down.
choice_data_list: This! Core trai—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: これ！体幹トレ――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I'd think using it normally while 
doing desk work would be fine, though...
choice_data_list: ……ニングのあと休むのに使えそうだな！
……ニングのあと休むのに使えそうだね！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waterbeds sound so nice. I hear they're 
super comfy to sleep on.
choice_data_list: Alright! I think I'll lie down for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm, excuse me, valued customer, I am 
terribly sorry. This is strictly for 
display only...
choice_data_list: よし！寝転がってみようかなっ！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so you make careless mistakes like 
that too, Trainer-san~. That's pretty 
rare, isn't it?
choice_data_list: わぁ！すみません！！

text_block_list.text:
I'm just spinning my wheels. Or rather, 
while trying to heal myself...
choice_data_list:
(If anything, I'm feeling kind of worn 
out...)

text_block_list.text:
Having someone like me next to her would 
probably keep Hishi Miracle from relaxing. 
Thinking that, I glanced over to check on 
her, and—
choice_data_list: （むしろ疲れが……）

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the "Melt-Into-Butter Cushion." I want 
one, but I can't afford it~. Guess I'll 
just get some comfort here~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my whole body feels like it's melting 
away~. This is bad... I'm legit getting so 
sleepy...
choice_data_list: (...I'm genuinely feeling so soothed.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Everything in the interior here is round, 
huh? The plump shapes are so cute~, it's 
really soothing."
choice_data_list: （……フツーに癒されてる）

text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle speaks in such a relaxed, 
melting voice. Seeing her so completely 
unwound in body and mind warms my heart.
choice_data_list:
You're good at 'healing yourself,' aren't 
you

You're really good at "healing yourself," 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this all of a sudden~?
choice_data_list: 君は『自分を癒す』のが上手だな
貴方は『自分を癒す』のが上手だね

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I've always loved this kind of 
thing~ I've got all sorts of merch and 
stuff too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, on the other hand... looks 
like they're bad with that?
choice_data_list: Yeah...
That's true...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. You're super serious, Trainer. 
Maybe you should try learning a thing or 
two from me~
choice_data_list: そうだな……
そうだね……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What is...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes???
choice_data_list: ヒシミラクルさん！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: ――俺の癒しトレーナーになってください！
――私の癒しトレーナーになってください！

text_block_list.text:
After spending the whole day with her, I'm 
certain. She's a master at unwinding. 
She's the perfect person to learn from.
choice_data_list: 『癒しの時間』の取り方を知りたいんだ
『癒しの時間』の取り方を知りたいの

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
N-No, well... Wouldn't it be better to 
look it up online...? To find what suits 
you...
choice_data_list: I trust you more than the internet!
I trust you more than the internet!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: ネットより君のほうが信用できる！
ネットより貴方のほうが信用できる！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh... Really? You think so?
choice_data_list: ネットより君のほうが俺に詳しい、はず！
ネットより貴方のほうが私に詳しい、はず！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm the only one...
choice_data_list: 俺のトレーナーは君しかいない！！
私のトレーナーは貴方しかいない！！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Only me, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you put it like that, it'd feel 
kinda bad to turn you down~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, if it's strictly about relaxation? 
Maybe I know a tiny bit? More than 
average, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So, well—shall we give it a little try?
choice_data_list: Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Why does this whole situation feel 
so familiar...?
choice_data_list: ありがとう……！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Well, whatever. For now, maybe next time 
we go out, we can just laze around and 
check out some relaxing spots~
choice_data_list:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer!
What should we do in the meantime?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, this feels so weird! To think 
Trainer is a Trainer...
choice_data_list: よろしくお願いします！トレーナーさん！
それまでの間はどうしていましょう！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since we're here, shall we go all 
out and whip you into shape~? Just like 
Trainer usually does.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe study on my own? But I feel 
like I'd get way too carried away with 
it~.
choice_data_list: You catch on quickly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we've spent quite a lot of time 
together, haven't we~? Maybe I should make 
a rule like "Self-study forbidden!"?
choice_data_list: よくおわかりで……
